findings.summary: Replacing pid_state(pid) with pid_alive(pid) in claim_liveness treats non-ESRCH/non-EPERM OSErrors from os.kill(pid, 0) as DEAD instead of UNKNOWN, causing callers such as jobs.reclaim and startup._abandon_dead to falsely treat live processes as dead and prematurely reclaim legacy claims or abandon active startup prompts when probing is denied.
